name: lq20261107_515_manual_execution_perf
comment: ANCHOR: LQ20261107_515_MANUAL_EXECUTION_PERF — /v3/manual-execution polled three endpoints at 10-19 s: technical-grades re-parsed the 10.8 MB enrichment cache twice per symbol, symbol-cards ran DISTINCT ON over the whole ticker_snapshot_daily history plus a synchronous analyst backfill, open-trades read every stored market_quotes row for the held symbols. Pins one parse per file version, one enrichment read per symbol, the windowed+targeted perf lookup, and the per-symbol lateral quote read. Hermetic: fake file, module, db_query and connection.
